name: Allen & Heath AHM
notes: Plain JavaScript module (src/actions.js, src/feedbacks.js); every action and feedback is registered in getActions and getFeedbacks, no entries were left out. Control is over MIDI over TCP for the AHM-16, AHM-32 and AHM-64 (README of the module; the device type is the ahm_type config option).

The number of inputs and zones follows the configured AHM type (16, 32 or 64, default 64 when the type is invalid); control groups are fixed at 32 (main.js:88-93). The catalog records the maximum of the AHM-64 and marks it in the option description; the number fields set clampValues: false so values from a larger type are kept.

The option ids come from the shared builders in src/actions.js:43-160 (listOptions: number; muteOptions: mute_number and mute; setLevelOptions: setlvl_ch_number and level; adjustLevelOptions: incdec_ch_number and incdec) and generateNumberOptions in src/feedbacks.js:38-52. The level dropdown ids are indexes into the 128 dBu steps of dbu_Values.
Feedback types: the boolean feedbacks have no options beyond the channel numbers; the value feedbacks return the level in dBu.
Not catalogued: variables, presets and the upgrade scripts.
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.0.0: expressions are supported for option values.
